subject.title: Bug: Telegram / Feishu / WeCom channels in Docker image 2026.6.10 do not expose multi-account configuration as documented

question: Should the remaining report be scoped as a shared core multi-account setup contract, or should maintainers split Telegram/Feishu and external WeCom behavior into their respective owners after a current Docker reproduction?
rationale: The evidence supports partial overlap with an existing wizard issue but not a single verified root cause across all three channels, and the prior review explicitly flagged the external-plugin boundary.

options.title: Reproduce and split by owner
options.body: Verify current Docker behavior per channel, keep shared wizard defects with the canonical tracker, and create or route only a distinct plugin-owned defect where evidence requires it.

options.title: Treat as one core setup bug
options.body: Adopt a shared core repair only after source and reproduction evidence prove the same setup contract fails across all three channels.

recommendation.title: Reproduce and split by owner
recommendation.body: Verify current Docker behavior per channel, keep shared wizard defects with the canonical tracker, and create or route only a distinct plugin-owned defect where evidence requires it.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable feature-history ownership could be gathered after the read-only command runner failed.
